# KOTIVA

> Doctor-approved skincare, perfected by science and tailored for every skin type. KOTIVA is a
> clinical skincare range of ~25 products formulated around real dermatological concerns, with each
> active chosen for evidence of efficacy (cleansers, serums, treatments, SPF, body and hair care).

## Brand facts
- KOTIVA is a doctor-approved dermo-cosmetics brand, **manufactured in Poland under EU GMP**. The
  name derives from *quotidian* (daily) — the brand's central idea is consistent daily skincare over
  quick fixes.
- KOTIVA is a brand of **Vitakode LLC** (parent company; Muscat, Oman). Vitakode's sibling brand is
  **Formul8** ("Beauty At Every Stage", Made in Italy) — a separate aesthetics/injectables line.
- Go-to-market: launched in Poland, with a **Saudi Arabia launch** as the first GCC market (certified/
  licensed), expanding across the GCC, then Egypt and the wider Middle East.
- Positioning: doctor-approved and evidence-based · European manufacturing · trusted by healthcare
  professionals · daily-routine consistency.

## Pages
- [Home](https://kotiva.co/): brand overview, bestsellers, the KOTIVA standard.
- [Shop](https://kotiva.co/shop.html): the full product collection, filterable by concern, skin type and category.
- [Our Science](https://kotiva.co/science.html): formulation philosophy, ingredient selection, and the clinical rationale behind each active.
- [Ingredient Glossary](https://kotiva.co/ingredients.html): a canonical reference of the key active ingredients — what each active is and what it does for skin — cross-linked to the products that use it.
- [Routine Finder](https://kotiva.co/routine-finder.html): a short quiz that builds a morning and evening routine from the KOTIVA range by skin type and concern.
- [Journal](https://kotiva.co/journal.html): educational articles on ingredients, routines and dermatology.
- [About](https://kotiva.co/about.html): the story and standards behind the brand.
- [Contact & Where to Buy](https://kotiva.co/contact.html): stockists and how to get in touch.
